purpose: Collapse repetitive same-repo feature release work into a trusted GitHub Actions gate without weakening Funnel, CI, stale-base, or owner-observability rules.
eligibility: Pull request head is in bassseamoor/render-queue, not a fork.
Auto-release marker parses and release_mode is auto.
No authority-sensitive or workflow-governance paths are changed.
Branch is current with main; stale branches are updated and rechecked.
Pulse recovery checks exist and pass.
Every observed pull-request workflow for the same head SHA is complete without failure.
actions: If stale, update branch from main and wait for rerun.
If any gate fails, do not merge.
If all gates pass, squash-merge using the exact verified head SHA.
After merge, append a Dev Feed main-stage receipt directly from the trusted workflow.
If trajectory metadata is supplied, append a canonical Trajectory checkpoint.
security: Automation runs from workflow_run using trusted workflow code on main.
It never checks out or executes pull-request head code with a write-capable token.
The bot cannot mint Funnel receipts; it only records a supplied receipt reference and relies on CI/Funnel verification already present in the repository.
honest_limits: This removes mechanical release steps, not build/verification time.
GitHub Actions scheduling latency still exists.
Receipt commits after merge may trigger follow-on Pages/check workflows, but they no longer require another manual PR.
Live deployment remains a separate state from merge/Pulse registration.
